operations.name: app.guide
operations.description: How sheets, cells, formulas and ranges work in this app, the supported functions and error codes, and what the person sees.

operations.name: sheets.list
operations.description: The sheet tabs in order, with their size and last change.

operations.name: sheets.get
operations.description: One sheet's structure: columns (name, type, width), rows, frozen panes, row heights, used range, counts.

sheet.description: Sheet id, or exact tab name (optional when the workbook has one sheet)

operations.name: sheets.create
operations.description: Add a sheet tab of 12 empty text columns × 30 rows, as New / + Sheet does.

operations.name: sheets.rename
operations.description: Rename a sheet tab.

sheet.description: Sheet id, or exact tab name (optional when the workbook has one sheet)

name.description: New tab name (trimmed, not empty, max 255)

if_updated.description: Refuse (409) if the sheet changed since this "updated" value from an earlier read

operations.description: Delete a sheet tab and all its cells.

if_updated.description: Refuse (409) if the sheet changed since this "updated" value from an earlier read

operations.name: sheets.import-csv
operations.description: Create a new sheet from CSV text, as Import does for a .csv file (at most 5,000 rows × 256 columns; the rest is cut).

csv.description: The CSV file text (separator , ; tab or | is detected)

operations.name: sheets.export-csv
operations.description: A sheet as CSV values (not formulas), as the CSV button writes it; the app's file also starts with a UTF-8 byte-order mark.

sheet.description: Sheet id, or exact tab name (optional when the workbook has one sheet)

operations.name: cells.read
operations.description: What the grid shows for a range: raw text, computed value or error, display text, format.

sheet.description: Sheet id, or exact tab name (optional when the workbook has one sheet)

range.description: Cells to read (default: every used cell); grid view needs one rectangle

view.description: cells = list of non-empty cells; grid = rows of display text

limit.description: cells view: at most this many cells (default 500, max 5000)

offset.description: cells view: skip this many cells

operations.name: cells.find
operations.description: Find cells whose raw text (formulas included) contains a string, as Find does.

sheet.description: Sheet id, or exact tab name (optional when the workbook has one sheet)

operations.name: cells.set
operations.description: Type values or formulas into cells, as in a cell or the formula bar; an empty value clears a cell (its formatting stays).

sheet.description: Sheet id, or exact tab name (optional when the workbook has one sheet)

raw.description: What to type into ref; text starting with = is a formula

if_updated.description: Refuse (409) if the sheet changed since this "updated" value from an earlier read

operations.description: Paste a block of values from a start cell, as pasting text does; the grid grows to fit and existing formatting stays.

sheet.description: Sheet id, or exact tab name (optional when the workbook has one sheet)

text.description: Rows separated by line breaks, cells by tabs

if_updated.description: Refuse (409) if the sheet changed since this "updated" value from an earlier read

operations.description: Clear the contents of cells and keep their formatting, as the Delete key does.
